title: "Coding agents"
toc: false
---

The single source of truth for humans and coding agents (Copilot, Claude,
Cursor, Hermes, etc.) working on Trishula is
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
in the [`trishula`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula) repository.
Tool-specific files (`CLAUDE.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`) point
there; when anything disagrees, **AGENTS.md wins**.

Read it at the source — the GitHub-rendered page is always current, with
the file's own table of contents at its usual anchors:

- [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/blob/main/AGENTS.md) —
  the guide: project map, testing standard, layer map, signing, the ADR
  process ([`docs/adr/`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/tree/main/docs/adr)),
  PR contract, labels, security rules.
- [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) —
  the working agreement (ground rules, PR template).

This page intentionally does not mirror the file: a mirror drifts the moment
the repo moves, and the source-of-truth rule (AGENTS.md wins) already says
where to look.
